Name: The Peanuts Pack (Json Assets)
Author: deleted78899363
Description:
The [i]Good Grief Shirt [/i]is nice, but what if we had shirts for other Peanuts characters? This mod adds three new shirts based off of Peanuts characters, other than Charlie Brown. It also adds Linus's Blanket as a weapon you can purchase from Marlon!

This was a quick idea I had, and it didn't take me long to make this. Let me know about any bugs so I can get them sorted out!

You need Json Assets for this mod, which in turn needs SpaceCore. The weapon can be purchased from Marlon, but the shirts will need to be spawned in using CJB Item Spawner.

[b][size=1]Also, I'm gonna put a dedication to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3946892]MissCoriel[/url]﻿ because I looked over their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4306]Sailor Moon Weapons[/url] as research to figure out the formatting for the Blanket. Please check it out![/size][/b]

Downloads.Description:
Initial release. Adds three shirts and a new weapon!

Make sure you have Json Assets and SpaceCore installed. Unzip into your Mods folder.
